entries.label: 3D Printer
cells: Using the new Star Talent (on the 2nd tab of Star Talents), you can collect samples to start printing resources!

entries.label: Atom Collider
cells: Accelerate enough material to high speeds, and you can create the first physical atoms in this pixellated world!

entries.label: Automation Arm
cells: Automate some of the more tedious actions with the flip of a switch! Let the robots do the dirty work!

entries.label: Boulder Roller
cells: Rolls a boulder forward.

entries.label: Chest Space
cells: Just gives more Storage Chest slots, straight up. I gotchu dawg, yeh. (Passive Upgrade)

entries.label: Clover Shrine
cells: Boosts Drop Rate of players on this map by +15%.

entries.label: Cost Cruncher
cells: Reduces the resource costs of upgrading buildings. Doesn't affect 'building' phase cost (Passive Upgrade)

entries.label: Crescent Shrine
cells: Boosts Crystal and Giant Spawn chance on this map by +50%.

entries.label: Crystal Shrine
cells: Boosts the Lv Up Rate of all Shrines on this map by +20%.

entries.label: Death Note
cells: Defeat TONS of monsters to boost your Multikill Rate for each world. Upgrading this tower also boosts your base Multikill Bonus in all worlds.

entries.label: Fireball Lobber
cells: Lobs exploding fireballs.

entries.label: Frozone Malone
cells: Casts a wave of freezing snow.

entries.label: Isaccian Shrine
cells: Boosts Max HP and DEF of players on this map by +12%.

entries.label: Kraken Cosplayer
cells: Summons eyeball defenders.

entries.label: Pantheon Shrine
cells: Boosts Carry Capacity of players on this map by +10%.

entries.label: Party Starter
cells: Confetti!

entries.label: Poisonic Elder
cells: Poisons enemies.

entries.label: Primordial Shrine
cells: Boosts AFK Gain Rate on this map by +1%.

entries.label: Pulse Mage
cells: Zaps a single nearby monster.

entries.label: Salt Lick
cells: Spend refinery salts and other World 3 Resources in return for bonuses from the hungry blobulytes!

entries.label: Stormcaller
cells: Smites enemies with lightning

entries.label: Summereading Shrine
cells: Boosts ALL Exp Gain of players on this map by +6%.

entries.label: Talent Book Library
cells: Relive your youth by checking out books, and further relive your youth by never returning them! Instead, use them to boost your talent max levels.

entries.label: Trapper Drone
cells: Remotely deploy AND collect traps to and from any discovered critter location! Collect-all is based on Hunter's Eagle Eye Talent.

entries.label: Undead Shrine
cells: Boosts Respawn Rate of monsters on this map by +5%.

entries.label: Voidinator
cells: Casts a wave of null and void, removing enemy colours.

entries.label: Woodular Shrine
cells: Boosts Total Damage of players on this map by +12%.

pageProps.seoDescription: Every one of the 27 buildings in Legends of Idleon, and what each one connects to.
